note: General guidance for drafting ads, not legal advice, and platform policies change: check the current Meta and TikTok ad policies before a paid campaign. The Wizard Agent applies the pack that matches the CLIENT's niche to every ad, on top of each template's own compliance list. 'match' terms drive the validator's regulated-niche check (plurals including -ies are matched); each pack's 'exclude' terms are innocent look-alikes for that pack only. 'banned_phrases' are regular expressions the validator blocks in the copy when the pack applies. 'key_phrases': a template matched to a pack must carry at least one compliance rule containing one of these phrases. 'disclosure': the on-screen line the ad itself must show (as {{disclosure}} in a beat or slide). If a client's niche looks regulated but no pack matches, the agent stops and asks a human. Platform notes reflect the builder's understanding on reviewed_on and have not been checked against the live policy pages.

rules: Label realistic AI-generated people or scenes using the platform's AI-content label (Meta 'AI info', TikTok AI-generated label).
Never show a generated face as a real customer, patient, employee or reviewer. Testimonials, before/after and real staff use real_photo beats only, with written consent.
Clones use only the client's own face and voice, with written consent on file.
No real person's likeness, real brand, real song lyrics or melody, or named-artist sound-alike.
Ask for comments only with a genuine question. No 'tag a friend', 'like if', or vote-bait lines (Meta demotes engagement bait).
Performance lines in why_it_works are the expected mechanism, not measured results; never present them to a client as proven numbers.
Paid partnerships and creator posts carry the platform's paid-partnership label or #ad (FTC endorsement rules).
No ads aimed at children under 13; anyone under 18 shown only with a parent or guardian's written consent.
Text that must be readable (words, prices, numbers) is added as an overlay in the edit, never left to a video model to draw.
If no pack matches the client's niche, {{disclosure}} is an empty string, never another niche's line.
AI-only images and music may not be protected by copyright; tell clients they may not own exclusive rights to purely AI-generated parts (not proven yet; check current law and provider terms).
Label as attorney advertising where the state bar requires it.
No guarantees or predictions of outcome; past results do not guarantee future results.
Not legal advice; no attorney-client relationship is formed by the ad.
No 'specialist' or 'expert' claims unless certified under state rules.
packs.disclosure: Attorney advertising. Past results do not guarantee a similar outcome.
packs.platform: Meta and TikTok allow legal services ads; state bar rules apply.

rules: No guaranteed results or cure claims; 'results vary' on screen next to any outcome.
Before/after only with real patients, written consent and a disclaimer; never generated.
No patient details or health information without written consent (HIPAA in the US).
No diagnosis in the ad; invite a consultation instead.
Licensed practitioner and practice name shown where required.
Cosmetic procedures: no "painless", "risk-free" or "permanent" claims; state that results vary.
packs.disclosure: Results vary. Consult a licensed provider.
packs.platform: Health ads face extra review; Meta restricts before/after images and negative self-perception in health and weight ads. Addiction treatment needs platform certification (e.g. LegitScript). Check current policy.

rules: No promised returns, income or approval; past performance does not guarantee future results.
Any rate shown needs APR and key terms; show NMLS number for mortgage and lending.
Insurance: no guaranteed coverage or premiums; carrier and license details where required.
Required firm or regulator disclosures (SEC/FINRA/state) stay on screen long enough to read.
Crypto and trading: state the risk of loss plainly.
Mortgage and lending ads add the NMLS number to {{disclosure}} (e.g. 'Not financial advice. Terms apply. NMLS #123456.').
packs.platform: Credit, loans and financial products are a Meta Special Ad Category: no targeting by age, gender or ZIP. Payday and some crypto ads are restricted or banned. Check current policy.

rules: Follow fair housing rules: no wording that prefers or excludes any protected group.
Show brokerage name and license number where required.
No guarantees on sale price, speed or appreciation.
Label virtually staged or AI-edited room images as such.
Put the brokerage name and license number in {{disclosure}} after the Equal Housing line (e.g. 'Equal Housing Opportunity. Bayline Realty, DRE #01234567.').
packs.platform: Housing is a Meta Special Ad Category: no targeting by age, gender or ZIP.

rules: Supplements: FDA disclaimer; no claims to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent disease.
No guaranteed weight loss, body or skin results; typical results stated if a result is shown.
Before/after only with real, consenting customers and a 'results vary' disclaimer.
No unrealistic body images or shaming language.
packs.disclosure: Results vary. These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA.
packs.platform: Meta and TikTok restrict before/after images and weight-loss claims; no targeting under 18 for weight-loss products. Check current policy.

rules: Target only adults of legal age, using platform age-gating.
No appeal to minors; no actors who look under 25.
No health, performance or 'gets you' effect claims; follow local law on what may be advertised at all.
Gambling: show odds/terms and a responsible-gambling message where required.
packs.disclosure: For adults of legal age only. Please enjoy responsibly.
packs.platform: Alcohol ads must be age-gated; cannabis, tobacco and firearms ads are banned or heavily restricted on Meta and TikTok. Check current policy before any paid ad.

rules: No income, revenue or 'quit your job' promises; any results shown are labelled as not typical, with typical results stated.
Testimonials must be real, consented and representative.
packs.disclosure: Results not typical. No income is guaranteed.
packs.platform: Meta and TikTok restrict ads that promise income or "get rich" results.

packs.triggered_by: Any template that offers a prize, contest, giveaway or winner.
rules: Official rules linked: eligibility, start and end dates, how the winner is picked, prize value.
No purchase necessary where the law requires it; void where prohibited.
Say the promotion is not sponsored or run by the platform.
Pick winners by the stated method only (random draw or judged), never by likes.
packs.disclosure: No purchase necessary. Official rules at link.
packs.platform: Not sponsored or run by the platform; follow Meta Promotions Guidelines.
Employment is a Meta Special Ad Category: no targeting by age, gender or ZIP.
rules: No wording that prefers or excludes any protected group.
State real pay ranges where the law requires them.

packs.disclosure: Plus tax, title and fees. See dealer for details.
packs.platform: Auto loan offers fall under Meta's credit Special Ad Category.
rules: Advertised prices include all fees except tax and title, or say what is excluded.
Financing offers show APR, term and credit requirements.

packs.platform: No ads targeted at children under 13; minors' images need parental consent.
rules: Only show children with written parent or guardian consent; never generate a realistic child as a real customer.
Speak to parents, not to the children.

packs.platform: Meta and TikTok require advertiser authorization and a 'Paid for by' disclaimer for social issue, election or political ads; TikTok bans paid political ads.
rules: Always stop and get a human (and the client's compliance contact) to approve before writing.
Show 'Paid for by <sponsor>' exactly as registered.
No AI-generated likeness of any real candidate or official.
